## Summary
Zhuolian (Shenzhen) Communication Co., Ltd holds a single IEEE MA-L block, 68:8F:C9, registered 5 December 2019 with no later update [2][3]. The registrant address is care of "Shengli electromechanical Co., Ltd." at 201, No.19, Xixiang section, Guangshen Road, Jingbei community, Xixiang street, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, China [2][4]. No company website, product listing, FCC grant, teardown or security advisory for this vendor could be reached in this session, so what a device in this block is, which radios it carries and whether it randomizes its MAC are all undocumented ("no public documentation found for Zhuolian (Shenzhen) Communication"). Web search was unavailable in this session (per-session search budget exhausted), so coverage here is limited to directly fetchable registries; the live IEEE oui.txt itself answered HTTP 418, so the registry facts come from maclookup.app and the registry copy in the repository. A later pass with search may find more.
